document.content:
# Operator Health Check

Checked at 2026-03-12 04:51 UTC.

## Summary
- PM2: mostly healthy; 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`)
- Docker: multiple healthy workloads running; 1 restarting container (`langfuse_langfuse-web_1`), 2 unhealthy containers (`lidaros-frontend-1`, `omiximo-email-automation`)
- Disk: `/` at 69% used (210G free)
- RAM: 11.3 GB used / 27.5 GB total (~41%), no swap configured
- GPU: RTX 4090 present; 20.6 GB / 24.6 GB in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`, GPU util 0%, temp 40C
- OpenClaw gateway: RPC responding on loopback `127.0.0.1:18789`, but `openclaw gateway status` reports systemd runtime as stopped/inactive with an out-of-date service config

## PM2
Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
Stopped: whisper

## Docker concerns
- Restarting: `langfuse_langfuse-web_1`
- Unhealthy: `lidaros-frontend-1`
- Unhealthy: `omiximo-email-automation`

## OpenClaw notes
- Gateway probe is OK on `ws://127.0.0.1:18789`
- Service mode shows disabled / inactive / last exit 203
- Service file appears outdated and embeds a gateway token
- Doctor warnings: WhatsApp + Telegram group allowlists are configured with empty allow lists, so group messages will be silently dropped until configured or policies are opened

## Recommended follow-up
1. Investigate why `whisper` is stopped in PM2
2. Check logs/healthchecks for `langfuse_langfuse-web_1`, `lidaros-frontend-1`, and `omiximo-email-automation`
3. Reconcile OpenClaw service state vs PM2-managed process and reinstall gateway service if systemd should own it
4. Review Telegram/WhatsApp group allowlist config if group intake is expected
